warrantyItems.item1: Most furniture products at River Furniture are produced in the factory of River Architecture Construction Joint Stock Company with a team of talented employees and workers along with modern facilities.
warrantyItems.item2: River Furniture offers a one-year warranty for cases of technical defects during production or installation.
warrantyItems.item3: Customers should not attempt repairs themselves, please contact River Furniture via the hotline: 088 6024 065.
warrantyItems.item4: After the warranty period expires, if customers have any requests or concerns, please contact Nhà Xinh for guidance and issue resolution.

nonWarrantyItems.item1: Customers who attempt to repair the product without notifying River Furniture.
nonWarrantyItems.item2: Products used contrary to the warranty instructions causing scratches, dents, dirt, or color loss.
nonWarrantyItems.item3: Products deformed by abnormal external conditions (too humid, too dry, pests, or unsuitable chemicals).
nonWarrantyItems.item5: Products without River Furniture's warranty card.
